get_response_values: get response values from a fitted classifier, outlier detector, or regressor using predict_proba or decision_function
get_response_values_binary: get response values from a binary classifier with auto fallback from predict_proba to decision_function
process_predict_proba: process predict_proba output to extract positive class column for binary or compressed format for multilabel
process_decision_function: process decision_function output by inverting sign for binary classifiers when positive label is classes[0]
test_get_response_values: test _get_response_values with a fitted classifier, X data, and response_method to validate output shape and pos_label
